note: No secrets here. Keys live in /home/jinxu/.hermes/.env. Weekly Tongji quota is tracked locally because the gateway has no public usage API.

modes.auto: Prefer primary while under weekly budget; on quota/auth/rate-limit errors mark exhausted and fall back.
modes.tongji_agi: Force Tongji AGI gateway (subject to weekly school quota).

deepseek_official.label: DeepSeek official
deepseek_official.notes: No school weekly cap known; treat as unlimited fallback.

tongji_agi.label: Tongji AGI gateway
tongji_agi.notes: Set TONGJI_AGI_WEEKLY_TOKEN_LIMIT (prompt+completion tokens) once you know the school cap. Until set, auto mode still prefers Tongji until an exhaust error or manual pin.
